If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is 0.33–0.67 and forecast is flat, adjust forecast to match recent 5-day average for late horizon (16–30 days).  
When sentiment spikes to 1.00 after a downward trend, add 2–3% to forecast for early horizon to capture reversal momentum.  
If sentiment is 0.00 and forecast is above 65, reduce forecast by 2–4% for mid horizon to avoid overconfidence bias.  
If sentiment is 0.00 and forecast is below 60, increase forecast by 1–3% for late horizon to counteract pessimism bias.
